Name: Vanilla Tweaks Style Eggs and Mayos
Author: LinSterling
Description:
[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
Back on my bullshit! I keep freaking out when I see an egg or a mayonnaise jar that doesn't match Vanilla Tweaks in my game, so here goes, I've spent days if my life scouring content files of various mods for eggs and mayo and then retexturing all of them, and made this abomination, have fun.
Saturated/Desaturated option included, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to pick the one you want. Default is Saturated.

Individual item toggles added as of 1.5.0. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure to your heart's content. Default is on for all sprites.

[b]Note on colour choice[/b]: I've generally followed a "shell colour = mayo colour" policy, which I feel fits Stardew logic pretty well. If you don't like that... well, crap. But you know, there are only so many shades of realistic mayo you can stare at before they all begin to look the same. My goal was to make sprites fit Vanilla Tweaks style better but also keep different eggs and mayos somewhat visually distinct. Once shape is more uniform, colour ends up doing a lot of the heavy lifting in that department. I'm always open to feedback and improvements but please cut me some slack, I've been drowning in mayo for a week at this point.

[b]Note on geese[/b]: I've made egg/jar shapes uniform between the various geese-adding mods, but tried matching their colours to their original sprites. Hopefully it's not too confusing. Also, I haven't even covered every goose mod out there. I'm overwhelmed and overgeesed. I'm spawning incorrect goose items to take screenshots. I'm losing the ability to tell the difference between shades of goose eggs...
Wait, it's all geese? Always has been.
🌍👨‍🚀🔫🪿

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
  1. Download
  2. Unzip
  3. Plonk "Vanilla Tweaks Style Eggs and Mayos" into Stardew Valley\Mods
  4. Should work unless I forked something (in that case, let me know)
  5. Enjoy your eggs. No one should enjoy mayo but you can try
  6. Maybe endorse this mod if you liked it? :3
